mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Backend Policy

This project uses rustls as its TLS backend. The decision was made because rustls is a pure Rust implementation and avoids the CVE exposure the project wanted to leave behind. Separately, the project enforces HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
